title: Bracket with mirrored arms
prompt: U-shaped holder: an 80 × 30 × 5 mm base plate centred on the origin on Z = 0, with an upright arm at each end: 5 mm thick (flush with the plate's short ends), 20 mm wide centred on the plate, reaching 35 mm above Z = 0. Each arm has an M4 clearance hole through it, 25 mm above Z = 0 and centred across the arm. The two ends are mirror images.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
An Ø4.5 hole through each arm, 25 mm up, on the centre line
The two ends mirror each other: centroid on X = 0
